name: Yacht Rock Band
spec: Three voices, keys, guitar, bass, drums and saxophone
alt: Two sailboats moored on still water at sunset.
blurb: This band plays the Doobie Brothers, Steely Dan, Hall and Oates, Toto and Christopher Cross, with three voices in harmony and the saxophone out front. It's an excellent choice for a summer party, and most of your guests will know the words.
